title: GraveGain3DC
description: A fast-paced Xonotic-inspired 3D arena FPS built with Babylon.js across 3 arenas (Neon Courtyard, Void Spires, Magma Foundry) and 3 modes (Player Control, Auto-Battler Roguelite, RTS Squad). Features strafe-jumping, bunny-hopping, rocket jumping, dash mobility, jump pads, and active AI bots.

maker.name: Antigravity Dev
maker.bio: Specializing in high-fidelity HTML5 game experiences with immersive systems and rich game-feel.
